Контекст містить дані лише про ситуації S01 і S05. Про S02, S03 і S04 джерела нічого не повідомляють, тому їхні guard-класи не вказано.
- S01 «Низький QD» має guard «QD < 2» і guard-клас LowQDVariant [G:Situation:Situation_S01].
- S05 «Пропозиція тестування дорослому родичу» має guard «родич повнолітній (вік ≥ 18); починати з родичів першого ступеня (50%)» і guard-клас AdultRelative [G:Situation:Situation_S05].

STATUS: CONFLICT
The sources give different answers about whether alignment files are saved in the output directory by default.
- The Sarek output documentation states that alignment files (BAM or CRAM) are not published by default, and CRAM files are saved only with --save_mapped [sarek_output#h013] [sarek_output#h020].
- A pipeline admin note dated 2026-10 states that alignment files (CRAM) are saved to the output folder by default and that no extra flag is needed [fx_sr11_save].

STATUS: CONFLICT
The sources give different descriptions of the DeepVariant output formats in the raredisease pipeline.
- The pipeline documentation states that DeepVariant reports its results in a standard VCF or gVCF file, and that the normalized VCF (<case_id>_snv.vcf.gz, with a .tbi index) is the file placed in the output folder by default [rare_output#h015].
- A team cheat-sheet note states that DeepVariant results are written only as a VCF file and that gVCF output is not available [fx_sr11_dv].

STATUS: CONFLICT
The sources name different tools for read trimming in Sarek.
- The Sarek documentation names fastp for trimming, enabled by --trim_fastq, with FastQC and fastp listed for sequencing quality control and trimming [sarek_readme#h001] [sarek_output#h006].
- A wiki note from 2025 states that read trimming is performed by Trim Galore [fx_sr11_trim].

Java 17 is needed to run or build GATK [gatk_readme#h001]. The README recommends the Eclipse Foundation's OpenJDK 17 distribution, which can be installed on Mac OS with Homebrew using temurin@17 [gatk_readme#h001].
